# SpaceLean AI — Construction Scheduling & Project Controls Platform

> SpaceLean is an AI-native construction scheduling and project controls platform designed for General Contractors, Project Owners, and Construction Consultants. It transforms 3D BIM models (IFC/Revit) into 4D buildable sequences, predicts critical path delays with 94% accuracy, and automates subcontractor trade coordination.

**Last Updated**: 2026-11-25  
**Full Context Reference**: [https://spacelean.ai/llms-full.txt](https://spacelean.ai/llms-full.txt) — Extended version with complete feature specs, pricing matrix, competitor dataset, and API documentation.

## Core Capabilities

- **BIM Model Visualisation**: Interactive 3D web-based IFC building model viewer. Inspect individual architectural, structural, and MEP components, review element-level properties, access model-based dimensional quantities (lengths, areas, volumes), and connect 3D geometry directly to 4D Gantt schedule tasks and construction timelines ([https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/bim-selection](https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/bim-selection)).
- **BIM-to-4D Sequencing (AI Sequencing Engine)**: Parses IFC and Revit models to automatically map spatial relationships, structural dependencies, and generate 4D construction timelines in under 60 seconds ([https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/ai-sequencing](https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/ai-sequencing)).
- **Monte Carlo Critical Path & Risk Prediction**: Runs 1,000 probabilistic schedule simulations per save based on historical trade velocity, zone congestion, and weather patterns to flag critical path risks with 94% accuracy ([https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/monte-carlo](https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/monte-carlo) and [https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/risk-analysis](https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/risk-analysis)).
- **Self-Healing Schedules (Resequencing Engine)**: Sub-second CP-SAT constraint solver automatically re-optimizes downstream task dependencies, float, and crew assignments when unexpected site delays occur, eliminating manual CPM replanning ([https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/resequencing](https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/resequencing)).
- **Construction Kanban Board**: Construction-native visual workflow management mapped to project phases and trade packages with sub-second sync to Gantt master schedules ([https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/kanban](https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/kanban)).
- **AI Task Generation & Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)**: Automated decomposition of natural language scopes or BIM models into hierarchical Work Breakdown Structures with historical duration estimates ([https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/task-management](https://spacelean.ai/space-lean-core/task-management)).
- **Subcontractor Trade Coordination**: Generates automated 2-week lookaheads, daily site activity logs, and trade-stacking alerts to prevent site congestion.
- **Enterprise Integrations**: Imports and exports Oracle Primavera P6 XML/XER, Microsoft Project (.mpp/XML), and buildingSMART IFC files natively.

## Free Construction Engineering Tools

SpaceLean provides free, browser-based project controls and engineering calculation tools:

- [Construction Safety Inspection Checklist](https://spacelean.ai/tools/safety-inspection-checklist) — Interactive OSHA/AEC compliant safety audit tool with severity scoring and downloadable PDF reports.
- [Critical Path Calculator (CPM)](https://spacelean.ai/tools/critical-path-calculator) — Calculate Early Start, Early Finish, Late Start, Late Finish, and total/free float for construction activity networks with instant CPM diagramming.
- [Construction Cost Calculator](https://spacelean.ai/tools/construction-cost-calculator) — Parametric cost estimation tool factoring in building type, square footage, quality tier, and regional labor multipliers.
- [Daily Site Report Generator](https://spacelean.ai/tools/daily-site-report) — Create standardized daily construction logs tracking manpower, weather conditions, equipment usage, and progress photos.
- [Project Handover Checklist](https://spacelean.ai/tools/handover-checklist) — Systematic closeout framework for O&M manuals, punch lists, warranties, and commissioning sign-offs.
- [Free AI Task Generator (WBS)](https://spacelean.ai/tool) — Instant AI work breakdown structure generator from plain-text project scope.

## Target Audiences & Use Cases

- **General Contractors (GCs)**: Eliminate trade-stacking conflicts, accelerate bid-level 4D schedule creation, and keep field crews aligned on critical path priorities.
- **Project Owners & Developers**: Gain real-time project intelligence, verify contractor milestone progress, and protect project ROI against cost overruns.
- **Construction Consultants & VDC Managers**: Offer clients 4D BIM sequence options and probabilistic delay analysis without weeks of manual Primavera P6 setup.
- **Industrial, Infrastructure & Commercial Projects**: Tailored scheduling logic for high-rise commercial structures, energy plants, highways, and civil infrastructure.

## Pricing Tiers

- **Free Tier**: $0/month — Includes 1 active project, basic AI task generator, 4D BIM viewer (up to 50MB IFC), and community support.
- **Pro Tier**: $19/user/month (billed annually) — Includes unlimited projects, full 4D BIM sequencing, 1,000-simulation predictive risk engine, Primavera P6 XML export, and priority support.
- **Enterprise Tier**: Custom pricing — Unlimited projects & storage, dedicated VDC onboarding, custom API/BIM integrations, single sign-on (SSO), and custom SLA guarantees.
